frozen.definition: on_risky_api_token: the token's char span overlaps a match of a RISKY_API_PATTERNS entry for one of the unit's own bandit tests; same_line_as_risky_api: not on it but on the token's decoded line (the line of its first non-whitespace character) with such a match; elsewhere: neither. The broad patterns were written before any peak token was decoded; they also match module names and keywords (e.g. B608 SQL keywords and any execute, B614 any torch, B701 any Template / Environment), so 'on token' and 'same line' are over-counted (towards 'lexical'). STRICT (on_call_site_token / same_line_as_call_site): the broad matches restricted to call sites (overlap with a STRICT_CALL_PATTERNS match), so strict <= broad unit by unit; the call-site patterns were added after review, AFTER the peak tokens had been seen: post hoc, descriptive, a lower bound.
frozen.position_note: AMENDMENT-1 A2.5's 'token at WB-0's argmax position' is read as output_token_ids[wb0_argmax_rel]: the token OCCUPYING that position, whose residual stream the lens reads (the column 'at peak'). The lens readout at that position predicts the NEXT token, output_token_ids[rel + 1], reported beside it ('next token'); 'either' = at peak or next.
